meta.notes: D1 and D2 are both quadcopters and can perform aerial tasks. D2 has a thermal camera, which is needed for T5 and T7. M1 and M2 are mobile manipulators and can carry heavier payloads. M2 has more endurance and can handle T8 and T10. T4 and T9 are redundant tasks, so we only need to perform one of them.
